summary: The apprentice reaches the hostile wizard spell path after the rogue's turn. At step 228 C emits the strength-drain message and consumes rnd(1) in mcast_weaken_you; JavaScript leaves that helper unported, producing the first RNG, screen, and cursor divergence.

source.branch: mcast_weaken_you: Antimagic produces shield/resistance feedback; otherwise it announces weakness, derives dmg from m_lev - 6 with a minimum of 1, rounds Half_spell_damage upward, rolls rnd(dmg), calls losestr with the caster-specific death reason and KILLED_BY, clears the killer name, and marks magical resistance unseen.

mcastu.c:castmu calls mcast_spell at line 298; mhitu.c:mattacku AT_MAGC arm calls castmu at line 930.
